verdict: Ads hit a cost-per-lead record low; intake pipeline needs attention now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 131 leads at $13.76 per lead — the lowest cost per lead recorded to date, down 10.74% from the prior week. Despite that volume, 111 contacts in your CRM produced zero pipeline opportunities, which points to intake follow-up as the current bottleneck, not ad performance. SMS automation and phone access tools that would improve contact rates are being activated now to close that gap. On the organic side, Google Business Profile actions fell sharply this week and are being addressed with a renewed posting cadence. Expect lead volume to hold steady while the intake and organic channels are brought back up to pace.

highlights.phrase: cost per lead this period — the lowest on record, down 10.74% week over week
leads received in the last 28 days, up 12.2% from the prior week
Google Business Profile actions this period, including 52 direct calls

watch_item.issue: 111 contacts entered the CRM this period but zero converted to pipeline opportunities, indicating leads are not being reached or qualified after they come in.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and phone access are being deployed this week to increase contact rate and move leads into active intake.
